exposure: Dinoprostone Vaginal pessary for cervical ripening
outcome: mode of delivery (vaginal delivery, cesarean delivery)
time interval from cervical ripening till delivery
cohort: 500 pregnant women with unripe cervix at term were recruited and randomly assigned to a cervical ripening group or an expectant management control group.
finding: Cervical ripening with Dinoprostone significantly increased vaginal deliveries (86% vs 64%) and shortened the application-delivery interval compared to expectant management.
mod_finding: Cervical ripening with Dinoprostone resulted in a significantly higher rate of vaginal deliveries and decreased cesarean delivery rate compared to expectant management.
